text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O and Narita Top Road both let 
victory slip away... Fixated on one 
another, their results suffered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More precisely, Narita Top Road had no 
choice but to remain conscious of T.M. 
Opera O— so overwhelming and imposing was 
her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing she couldn't leave her unchecked 
like this, Admire Vega resolved to defeat 
TM Opera O at the "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, Narita Top Road also decided 
to enter— but as things stood, her chances 
of winning were slim. She urgently needed 
to find a way to face the challenge.
